verdict.rationale: Freshsales documents instant self-serve access on signup with no credit card, plus kanban pipeline views, so a founder can start a pipeline without a partner. Getting real data in is evidenced only through API endpoints such as Bulk Upsert Contact, which takes developer work rather than a founder-friendly import. Missing for 10: a documented CSV/import or migration wizard from other CRMs, any evidence of time-to-working-pipeline under an hour, guided onboarding/setup documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can go from signup to a working pipeline with my real data in under an hour, without an implementation partner

citations.quote: When you sign up, you instantly get access to the fully-loaded CRM for 21 days.
Plan your entire sales process with kanban views, and configure and control with drag-and-drop cards.
